TestLargeColumn::test_large_columns_mixe.description: Single node; cassandra-stress writes 10k partitions with one 40KB column (2 threads), then runs a 15s mixed read/write workload over the same keys (8 threads). No explicit assertions: passes if c-s succeeds and the Tester teardown finds no crash/errors in the log. Guards scylla#1574 (assertion `lc._nesting` in managed_bytes::do_linearize(): MVCC snapshot removal merged large (fragmented) cells outside a linearization context).

origin.summary: Tomasz Grabiec: add mixed workload test stressing consistency algorithms, same day as scylla fix 1b2ea14d0e 'partition_version: Add missing linearization context' (Fixes #1574).
